payload.summary: Ranking-snapshot date gate will fail again around 3 Nov 2026 unless the snapshot is refreshed (audit H5-1)
payload.detail: The snapshot was refreshed to 4 Oct, so the automatic checks pass today. Refreshing it needs a paid live eval run, which always needs the owner's explicit approval. Ask for that approval before the end of October; this touches a RAG ranking surface, so follow docs/rag-behaviour/ and the canary rules.
